Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Please find our initial certification packet attached and answers inline below. We can follow up on any redactions/NDAs as needed.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_roster_2026-11.pdf; redwood_cloud_region_map_2026-11.png; SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2026.zip

Quick summary (high level):
- Subprocessor roster: list attached (roles: model serving, observability, SSO/auth, logging, metrics, CDN/edge). Each entry has primary region and secondary failover region.
- Cloud assurances: our hosted control plane uses multi-region GCP + Azure for redundancy in the US/EU; customer data plane for dedicated/private deployments can be pinned to customer region (see attached map).
- KMS/HSM: by default Redwood uses Redwood-managed customer-specific keys (envelope encryption) for hosted customers; for Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS/GCP KMS/HSM). See KMS answers below.
- SOC 2: redacted SOC 2 Type II report attached; full unredacted will be provided under NDA.

KMS specifics (short answers):
- Default (Hosted): Redwood-managed keys with envelope encryption. Keys are rotated per policy, and access is logged to our audit service with 365-day retention.
- Dedicated/Private: customer key ownership supported (AWS/GCP KMS or on-prem HSM). Logs can be exported to customer SIEMs upon request.
- Third-party edge provider (3rdPartyEdge): uses vendor-managed HSM for key wrapping; application-level keys are customer-unique but wrapped by vendor HSM. We maintain access logs and periodic attestation from the edge provider.

If you need a short one-pager for procurement, we can sketch a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) showing deliverables and timelines.

Next steps:
1) Confirm if the redacted SOC2 and the attached roster are sufficient for the initial intake.
2) If FinTechCo needs the unredacted SOC2 or vendor contracts, we can provide under NDA.
3) Marissa will follow up with a KMS/HSM addendum PDF that explains audit windows and vendor attestations in more detail.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — the packet looks good for intake. A couple of clarifying questions before we close the intake: 

1) For the third-party edge provider (3rdPartyEdge): can you confirm whether the HSM there is multi-tenant (vendor-managed) or if there is customer-dedicated HSM instances available? Our compliance team is particular about shared HSMs for certain payment flows.

2) For Hosted deployments: you mention 365-day audit log retention. Can logs be retained longer (e.g., 3 years) under contract, and is log export in a structured format (CloudTrail-like) available to customers on request?

3) Finally, please include a short note on whether any subprocessors have cross-border data transfers that would affect data residency controls for EU customers.

If you can answer these three bullets within the next business day we can move to procurement review.

Best,
Elena

Elena — quick answers and next steps below. Attaching a short KMS/HSM addendum and our cross-border subprocessors matrix.

Attachments: kms_key_handling_addendum_2026.pdf

1) 3rdPartyEdge HSM model: vendor offers shared HSM (multi-tenant) by default. For higher-assurance payment flows we can contract for a dedicated HSM instance in the vendor environment (procurement/price impact applies). We have a template addendum that documents key segregation and attestation cadence — see attached.

2) Log retention/export: hosted audit logs are retained 365 days by policy. We support extended retention up to 3 years under contract for enterprise customers; exports are available as structured JSON/CloudTrail-compatible records and can be delivered via secure transfer or pushed to a customer-owned S3/GCS bucket.

3) Cross-border transfers: the attached subprocessors matrix flags which providers transfer logs or telemetrics outside the EU. For our hosted EU nodes, customer PII is processed in EU regions only; failover to non-EU regions is restricted and requires opt-in.

Suggested MAP (high-level):
- Dec 1: Redwood provides final redacted SOC2 + roster (complete) — DONE (see Ben's packet).
- Dec 2: FinTechCo confirms whether dedicated HSM is required for 3rdPartyEdge; if yes, procurement to request quote.
- Dec 6: Procurement decision point for go/no-go on hosted vs dedicated deployment.

If you'd like, I can produce a one-page addendum that will sit in DocuSign for signature (SLA/data residency/KMS annex). Attached is the addendum draft; if it looks OK, Jordan can route DocuSign: DocuSign:ADDND-2026-RED-7781.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that would accelerate.
